historical_record.description: A building contract was recorded for the general work of fitting up the Forum Club on the first and second floors of the building known as the Press Club, at $7,300. Frederick H. Meyer was named as architect and Val Franz as contractor. The owner was the York Realty Co.

A building contract was recorded for sheet metal work for a four-storey and basement club house, at $1,973. F. H. Meyer was named as architect and Van Franz as contractor. The owner was the York Realty Company.

A building contract was recorded for concrete foundation work, sidewalk lights, basement floors and other concrete work for a four-storey and basement Class C building, at $6,447. F. H. Meyer was named as architect and the Foster Vogt Co. as contractor. The owner was the York Realty Co.

A building contract was recorded for heating for the four-storey and basement Class C building of the Press Club, at $1,465. Fred H. Meyer was named as architect and the General Engineering Co. as contractor. The owner was the York Realty Co.
